data.name: Club del fierro
data.detailed_description:
Limited Edition

Run today in our 1/4 & 1/8 mile, set of southern America


About the Game

Welcome to Club del Fierro!

Club del Fierro is a drag racing and simulation game inspired by Latin American car culture. Race on professional circuits, fully customize your car, and compete against other players online or solo to prove who’s the fastest.

Main Features:

  • Offline & Online Races: Compete in drag races against the AI or challenge other players online.

  • Full Customization: Modify engines, suspensions, wheels, appearance, and more to create your ideal car.

  • Wide Variety of Cars: Choose from over 70 classic and modern models, including iconic vehicles from the region.

  • Events, Rankings, and Global Leaderboard: Take part in weekly events, climb the rankings, and compete to become one of the fastest in the world!

  • Realistic Physics: Enjoy a realistic simulation of driving, acceleration, and car building.

  • Time-based Categories: Participate and become the best in your category. Categories are based on your times in 201, 250, and 402 meter races. It's not just about being the fastest, but about being the most precise!

Feel the passion for racing, show off your skills, and compete with players from around the world in Club del Fierro!

data.short_description: Argentine mile 1/4 career game. It contains rules based on category/time. Category drop, track invasion, overtaking, etc. If you like chopped or torn, this is your game.
